svg.aria-label: btwh-bridge runtime architecture: a Bosch Therm 4800i water heater over BLE into an ESP32-S3 bridge, out over MQTT to Home Assistant, with a separate remote-update path
svg.text: always on, one binary, no display
NimBLE: the only place it appears
the bridge reflashes itself; a bad image never touches the running firmware
live-only: a replay is a bug
One flasher, two triggers: the MQTT topic and the HA button. The serial command only prints the URL — no second parser to keep honest.
